title: Collect the served meals
prompt: Serve every order from the queue in turn and append each to a new array called served. Return served, which has the same meals in the same order.
hints: A while loop that moves items from one array to another.

docs.name: while condition:
docs.what: Repeats the indented lines as long as the condition stays true.

docs.name: list.pop_front()
docs.what: Removes the first item and returns it.

docs.name: list.append(value)
docs.what: Adds value to the end of the array. Returns nothing.

docs.name: list.is_empty()
docs.what: Returns true when the array has no items.
